criteria.given: the owner is signed in to the gate preview (GET /auth/preview) and the project "Demo Project" (slug "demo") exists
criteria.then: within the panel headed "Projects", the list item showing "Demo Project" contains a link whose accessible name is or begins with "New intent" and whose href is "/projects/demo/new"

criteria.given: the owner is signed in and on "/"
criteria.then: the browser is at "/projects/demo/new" with HTTP status 200, showing the h1 heading "New intent", a back link "← Demo Project", a field labelled "Title", a field labelled "What should be built or changed?" and a button "Record intent"
criteria.when: the owner clicks the "New intent" link in the "Demo Project" item of the "Projects" panel (a single click, no other interaction)

criteria.given: the owner is signed in and on "/"
criteria.then: there is exactly one such "New intent" link per project list item, and each one's href is "/projects/{slug}/new" for the project of the item it is in
criteria.when: the owner counts the project list items and the links whose accessible name is or begins with "New intent" inside the panel headed "Projects"

criteria.given: the owner is signed in and on "/"
criteria.then: the browser is at "/projects/demo" with HTTP status 200, showing the h1 heading "Demo Project" (the existing project navigation still works alongside the new shortcut)
criteria.when: the owner activates the link to "/projects/demo" in the "Demo Project" item of the "Projects" panel

criteria.given: the owner is signed in and on "/"
criteria.then: the browser is at "/projects/demo/new" showing the h1 heading "New intent"
criteria.when: the owner moves keyboard focus with Tab to the "New intent" link of "Demo Project" and presses Enter

criteria.statement: The "New intent" link is visibly identifiable as an action within each project row (consistent with the app's existing link/button styling), has a visible focus indicator, is not nested inside another link (no <a> inside <a>), and the Projects panel remains readable without horizontal scrolling at a 375px-wide viewport and on desktop.

interface.ui: Command page: route "/" (owner signed in; in the gate preview via GET /auth/preview, which redirects to "/"), page title "Command · Agents". Panel with heading (h2) "Projects" containing one list item per project, each showing the project name (preview: "Demo Project", slug "demo") and org/repo (preview: "preview-org/demo-repo"). NEW: inside each project's list item, a link with visible text "New intent" (accessible name "New intent", or beginning with "New intent", e.g. "New intent for Demo Project") whose href is "/projects/{slug}/new" (preview: "/projects/demo/new"). UNCHANGED: each project item still provides a link to "/projects/{slug}" whose accessible name contains the project name. Target page "/projects/{slug}/new": page title "New intent · Agents", heading (h1) "New intent", back link "← {project name}", text field labelled "Title", textarea labelled "What should be built or changed?", radio group "Risk tier" with "Standard" (default) and "Critical", submit button "Record intent".

non_goals: Changing the intent form at /projects/{slug}/new (fields, labels, validation, risk tier, submission, "Record intent" button) or how a recorded intent is processed.
Embedding or inlining the intent form on the Command page (e.g. a modal or inline form); the shortcut only navigates to the existing form.
Adding "New intent" shortcuts anywhere other than the Projects panel of the Command page (e.g. navigation bar, Active work, project page).
Changing the other panels of the Command page (Summary, Needs you, Proposed work, Operational flow, Active work, Live events, Accepted work) or the per-project active/accepted counts.
Creating, editing or removing projects; changing sign-in, sessions or authorization.

scope.summary: On the Command page (/), every project listed in the "Projects" panel offers a "New intent" link that opens that project's existing intent form at /projects/{slug}/new in one click. The intent form itself, its fields and its submission behaviour are unchanged; the existing navigation from a project entry to its project page (/projects/{slug}) keeps working.

title: New intent shortcut on the Command page
